Khud ko challenge karo.
"Believe karo ya na karo—right tum hi ho."
Empty cup se pour nahi hota.
"Success banne nahi—value ka banao."
"Thoughts action ke beej."
Goals ke level tak nahi—systems ke level tak girte ya chadhte.
Aaj ka effort kal ka advantage ban jata hai.
Tumhara kaam itna loud bolta hai, words sunai nahi dete.
Hamare peeche aur aage jo hai, woh humare andar jo hai usse chhota hai.
"Success destination nahi—journey hai."
Confidence ke bina success, bina foundation ghar jaisi.
